verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Risk Register with configurable risk scoring matrices (4x4/5x5), risk-to-control/action-item linkage, and assignable risk owners via role-based access, plus messaging that risks are mitigated 'in the same platform' rather than spreadsheets. However, there is no explicit evidence of formal risk treatment plan workflows or scheduled risk review cycles (only access-review cadences are documented, which is a separate feature). missing for 10: documented treatment-plan workflow, explicit risk review/reassessment cycle scheduling, and independent corroboration of the register's real-world use.
